title: Cobblemon: Armory Datapack Creator Kit
description: The Cobblemon: Armory datapack template for custom armors and items!
body:
# **Cobblemon: Armory – Datapack Creator Kit**

Bring your own Pokémon-themed armors into Cobblemon: Armory using this official datapack creator kit.

This datapack provides the framework needed to add fully custom armor sets, materials, items, and visuals without modifying the base mod. Designed for creators, modpack devs, and server owners who want to expand on experience with their own content.

## Features
- Add custom Pokémon armor sets using datapacks
- Add unique materials 
- Support for custom models, textures, and animations
- Built-in compatibility with GeckoLib armor rendering
- Works seamlessly with the Cobblemon: Armory mod
- No coding required – fully data-driven system

## What This Includes
Example armor set structure
Pre-configured datapack format
Resource pack layout for models, textures, and animations
Ready-to-use file paths and naming conventions
How to guide in the pack on how to make your own
Custom armor template

## Requirements
Cobblemon: Armory (v1.5.0 or newer)

## How It Works
### This datapack uses a structured system to register:
- Armor materials
- Armor pieces (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)
- Custom items and drops
- Model and animation references
- All assets are linked through consistent naming and folder structure, making it easy to expand or duplicate armor sets.

## Customization
You can:
- Create new armor sets for any Pokémon
- Add custom drops (e.g., scales, fur, shards)
- Assign unique models and animations
- Use custom model data for item icons
  
## Important
This is a creator resource, not a content expansion by itself
Requires proper setup of both datapack and resource pack
Do not redistribute modified versions of the core mod
